## Blueprint.indexes property

> This API is provided as a beta preview for developers and may change based on feedback that we receive. Do not use this API in a production environment.
> 

Explicit multi-column indexes. Column-level `.index()` / `.unique()` flags are not listed here; the grammar derives those at compile time.

**Signature:**
